Document reader dependencies added in BaoYi 0.17.0

PDF.js / pdfjs-dist 6.4.299 — Mozilla Foundation — Apache-2.0
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
License: pdfjs-license.txt. Bundled CMaps, standard fonts and WebAssembly
retain their upstream LICENSE files under dist/pdfjs/ in the application.
Text layer geometry CSS is adapted from PDF.js (Apache-2.0).

Marked 18.1.1 — MIT
https://github.com/markedjs/marked
License: marked-license.txt

DOMPurify 3.4.17 — Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0
https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify
Redistributed under Apache-2.0. License: dompurify-license.txt

These dependencies run locally. PDF workers, fonts, CMaps and decoder assets
are packaged with the app; the reader does not fetch them from a CDN.
